## The 800XL Is Back in the Game

First introduced in 1983, the fan-favorite 800XL bridged the gap between personal computing and gaming with its 64KB memory, custom chips for advanced graphics and sound, and full-sized keyboard. This modernized version adds built-in games, including Centipede, Boulder Dash, Battlezone, and more. The console supports additional 8-bit computer and Atari 5200 games, which can be loaded via USB.

## The Details

Features & Specs

• Faithful design features working cartridge slot and full-size mechanical keyboard.
• Includes updated THECXSTICK, a modern recreation of the joystick with eight buttons.
• 25 built-in games, including Centipede, Missile Command, M.U.L.E. and Battlezone.
• The cartridge slot supports most Atari 400, 800, XL, and XE cartridges.
• Also features support for software created for 8-bit computers and the Atari 5200 console.
• Load your own games and software from USB flash drives with cartridge, disk and cassette image support.
• 4 save slots per game.
• Rewind feature allows you to skip back up to 40 seconds.
• Built-in Atari BASIC.
• HDMI output with PAL (50Hz) and NTSC (60Hz) support, authentic 4:3 and pixel-perfect display modes, plus optional CRT filters.
• Choice of 12 display frames.
• Connect additional controllers and USB storage devices via four USB-A ports.

Shipping & Availability

Pre-orders open now. Shipping late April, 2027.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is THE 800XL?

THE 800XL is a recreation of the classic Atari 8-bit computer, featuring 25 built-in games, a full-size mechanical keyboard, working cartridge slot, HDMI output, and more. It includes the THECXSTICK 8-button joystick.

Which games are built into THE 800XL?

THE 800XL has 25 built-in games: Airball, Asteroids, Basketball, BattleZone, Berzerk, Boulder Dash, Bristles, Capture the Flag, Centipede, Crystal Castles, Elektraglide, Encounter, Flip and Flop, Henry’s House, Hover Bovver, Lee, M.U.L.E., Millipede, Miner 2049er, Missile Command, O’Riley’s Mine, The Seven Cities of Gold, Star Raiders II, Wavy Navy and Yoomp!

# Games Support Overview

Welcome to the Atari Games Support portal! Here you can find answers to frequently asked questions, or contact Atari for further support. 

Atari currently provides support for games listed in our Supported Games List.

For our currently supported games, we’ll do the best we can to get you the answer you’re looking for.

Legacy Games and Systems

Atari has published many hundreds of games over the last 50 years but we can’t actively support them all. We do not currently provide support for retro systems like the 2600, 5800, 7200, etc.

If you have questions about games or systems from our past, please check out our Support Channels article for a list of active community platforms for further support. 

Digital Platforms Game Purchases

If you purchased an Atari game from a non-Atari digital platform, please see the Digital Platforms Game Purchases article for additional information. We are unable to support transaction troubleshooting or returns support for games purchased on non-Atari digital storefronts.

Also features a high-res, 7-inch display, WiFi connectivity, HDMI, USB-C ports, and rechargeable battery. Available for pre-order now. 

### THE HANDHELD THAT’S A REAL CONTROL FREAK

## Overview

The latest in Atari’s collaboration with My Arcade, the Gamestation Go blends retro gaming with modern features. The handheld console comes packed with over 200 built-in games, including arcade and home console favorites from Atari’s massive library, along with officially licensed games from PAC-MAN, Jaleco, and PIKO International. The Gamestation Go even includes five games from the Atari Recharged Series and Balls of Steel for the first time on a My Arcade console.
The integrated paddle, d-pad, trak-ball, numeric keypad, bumpers, and classic gamepad buttons (A,B,X,Y) allow you to play every game in the collection with the controls it was designed for. "SmartGlow" technology highlights what controls work best with each game. The 7-inch high-resolution display, game save options, and WiFi connectivity upgrade the experience for modern gamers. Play on the big screen with HDMI output and USB-C ports to attach external controllers. Also includes a pop-out stand and rechargeable battery with 4-5 hours of play time.

## Features

  * 200+ video games built-in, including 5 games from the Atari Recharged Series, Balls of Steel, and PAC-MAN.
  * High resolution 7” full color display.
  * Integrated paddle, trak-ball and keypad.
  * Built in Wi-Fi® for easy updates.
  * SmartGlow™ technology makes gameplay intuitive by illuminating the controls needed for each game.
  * Powered by a built-in rechargeable battery with 4-5 hours playtime.
  * Includes HDMI cable, USB charging cable, and USB AC adapter

## Availability

Available now! Ships in 2-3 days.
